title: fix: Init*Active flags not cleared on error in C_SignInit/VerifyInit/DecryptInit
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c, C_SignInit sets s->sign_active=1 and then falls through to cleanup on validation failure without clearing it. Same pattern in C_VerifyInit (verify_active) and C_DecryptInit (decrypt_active). This leaves the session in a corrupted active-operation state, causing subsequent C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt to execute with an invalid key or mechanism handle.

Trigger: Call C_SignInit with a null key handle or invalid mechanism on a logged-in session.
Bad behavior: Subsequent C_Sign finds sign_active=1 and proceeds with stale/invalid key, producing undefined behavior or incorrect cryptographic output.

Fix: Clear *_active = 0 on all error-goto paths in each of the three Init functions, or move the *_active=1 assignment after all validation checks pass.
